integrity: The two input papers are cited for the operator closure, absorber bound and ring spectrum. The new contribution is the star-specific complete spectral reduction, sharp topology crossover and throughput asymptotics. No independent validation claimed.
scientific_limitations: Exact pair-projector sector of unit-per-edge-rate singlet feedback; full Lindbladian gap is only bounded within a factor two by this rate. High-degree star hub has unbounded aggregate incident measurement rate at growing qubit count, so no hardware-parallel-depth or per-site-rate superiority is claimed. Finite tests corroborate but do not prove all-size spectra. Independent priority assessment remains pending.
title: Star-graph feedback reaches the absorber-limited rate and overtakes a ring at seven qubits
